reviews.title: How delusional can Lebara be?
reviews.body:
How out of touch can Lebara be? They keep calling to ask why I’m leaving—and asking me to delete my reviews.

After I reported suspected fraud and my bank reclaimed the unauthorised payments, Lebara barred my service for 11 days. I was cut off from a service I relied on for work and family responsibilities. My requests for help were ignored or left without proper follow-up. Lebara refused to restore my service unless I reversed the chargeback or paid the disputed amount, describing it as a financial loss to the company.

My complaint is now with the Communications Ombudsman. Lebara promised to provide a Deadlock Letter by 8 October but still hasn’t. I believe withholding a letter it promised while the Ombudsman investigates is wilfully obstructive.

Instead of addressing my complaint, Lebara is asking me to delete my reviews. The answer to why I’m leaving should be obvious.

reviews.title: I was told that Lebara would provide a…
reviews.body:
I was told that Lebara would provide a Deadlock Letter. I asked for it by 8 October, but I have not received it.

Given their commitment to provide the letter and the deadline I set, I believe this delay is an attempt to obstruct the Ombudsman’s investigation and is wilfully uncooperative.

I escalated complaint because of Lebara’a handling of my complaint following being a victim of fraud and them subsequently barring my service and refusing to restore it on top of many communication attempts they ignore.

Instead of providing the letter, Lebara has asked me to delete my reviews. This makes me feel that managing its public reputation is being prioritised over cooperating and their customers. I will not be deleting my reviews and I will continue to post daily updates until you comply.

Avoid this provider at all costs! Once my issues are resolved I will be switching!
